info.title: China Planet Customer Mobile API
info.description: Read-only customer API. Entity and customer ownership are always derived server-side from the authenticated external Dolibarr user. Project progress is derived from the eight operational evidence stages shared with the web portal; internal Kanban progress is not exposed.
